ko.title: 실적 발표 컨퍼런스 콜에서의 관세: 기업들이 비용과 가격에 대해 투자자들에게 전하는 말

segments.src: As third-quarter earnings season gets under way, one topic keeps surfacing in prepared remarks and analyst Q&A: import duties.
segments.tr: 3분기 실적 시즌이 시작되면서 준비된 발표문과 애널리스트 질의응답에서 계속해서 수면 위로 떠오르는 주제가 있습니다. 바로 수입 관세입니다.

segments.src: Executives are being asked how much tariffs are costing them, how much of that cost they can absorb, and how much will eventually show up on price tags.
segments.tr: 임원들은 관세로 인해 얼마의 비용이 발생하는지, 그 비용 중 얼마를 자체적으로 흡수할 수 있는지, 그리고 최종적으로 얼마가 가격표에 반영될 것인지에 대한 질문을 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: For consumers, these calls offer an early read on what may be coming to store shelves, showrooms, and online checkout pages.
segments.tr: 소비자들에게 이러한 컨퍼런스 콜은 상점 진열대, 쇼룸, 온라인 결제 페이지에 곧 닥칠 상황을 미리 파악할 수 있는 단서를 제공합니다.

segments.src: This guide explains what to listen for, how to interpret common phrases, and what the answers could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 무엇에 귀를 기울여야 하는지, 흔히 쓰이는 표현들을 어떻게 해석해야 하는지, 그리고 그 답변이 가계 예산에 어떤 의미를 가질 수 있는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며, 투자나 재무 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why earnings calls matter for the tariff story
segments.tr: ## 실적 발표 콜이 관세 이야기에서 중요한 이유

segments.src: Government trade data and economic reports tell us what is moving across borders.
segments.tr: 정부의 무역 데이터와 경제 보고서는 국경을 넘어 이동하는 물량을 알려줍니다.

segments.src: Earnings calls tell us what companies are actually doing about it.
segments.tr: 실적 발표 콜은 기업들이 실제로 그에 대해 무엇을 하고 있는지 알려줍니다.

segments.src: Every quarter, public companies discuss:
segments.tr: 상장 기업들은 매 분기 다음과 같은 사안을 논의합니다:

segments.src: - **Cost of goods sold:** how much it costs to make or buy what they sell.
segments.tr: - **매출원가:** 판매하는 제품을 만들거나 구매하는 데 드는 비용.

segments.src: - **Gross margin:** the share of revenue left after those direct costs.
segments.tr: - **매출총이익률:** 그러한 직접 비용을 제외하고 남은 수익의 비율.

segments.src: - **Guidance:** what leadership expects for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: - **가이드라인:** 경영진이 다가오는 분기들에 대해 기대하는 바.

segments.src: - **Pricing actions:** whether, when, and by how much prices are rising.
segments.tr: - **가격 정책:** 가격이 오르는지, 언제 오르는지, 얼마나 오르는지.

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: 임원들은 애널리스트들의 직접적인 질문을 받기 때문에, 이러한 콜은 경영진이 자신의 계획에 대해 얼마나 자신감을 갖고 있는지 등 보도자료보다 더 많은 것을 드러내는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## 주요 표현과 그 일반적인 의미

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: 관세에 대한 언급은 비교적 예측 가능한 어휘로 이루어지는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: 알기 쉬운 말로 번역해 드립니다.

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **"우리는 영향을 완화하고 있습니다."**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: 기업은 공급업체와의 협상, 조달처 변경, 제품 재설계, 또는 기타 비용 절감을 통해 타격을 줄이려고 노력하고 있습니다.

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: 이는 가격이 계속 동결될 것이라는 의미는 아닙니다.

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **"우리는 비용의 일부를 흡수할 것으로 예상합니다."**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: 당분간은 이익 마진이 압박의 일부를 감당하게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: 비용 흡수는 대개 일시적이며, 관세가 유지되는 기간이 길어질수록 이를 지속하기는 더 어려워집니다.

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
segments.tr: **"선별적 가격 인상."**

segments.src: Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: 모든 제품의 가격이 오르는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: 기업들은 수요가 강하거나, 경쟁이 제한적이거나, 관세 노출도가 가장 높은 품목의 가격은 올리면서도 생필품이나 판촉 품목의 가격은 안정적으로 유지하는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **"외과 수술식" 또는 "타겟형" 가격 책정.**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: 위 내용과 유사합니다.

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: 전면적인 인상보다는 카테고리나 브랜드별 변화를 예상하십시오.

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"당겨서 들여오기" 또는 "관세 이전 재고 확보."**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: 기업이 관세가 인상되기 전에 여분의 상품을 미리 구매한 것입니다.

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: 이는 가격 변동을 지연시킬 수 있지만, 저비용 재고가 모두 소진되면 이후 분기에 더 높은 비용이 나타날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: 고객이 가격 변화에 얼마나 민감하게 반응하는지 나타냅니다.

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: 임원들이 탄력성을 논의할 때, 그들은 가격이 오를 경우 쇼핑객들이 더 저렴한 제품으로 갈아탈지, 구매를 미룰지, 아니면 발을 돌릴지 저울질하고 있는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## 애널리스트들이 집요하게 파고드는 부분

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: 답변만큼이나 질문에도 귀를 기울이십시오.

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: 흔히 다뤄지는 질문들은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **달러 기준 또는 마진의 백분율 기준으로 관세 노출은 얼마나 되는가?** 구체적인 수치는 기업이 상세한 계획을 세웠음을 시사하며, 모호한 답변은 불확실성을 나타낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **제품이나 투입재의 몇 퍼센트가 영향을 받는 국가에서 오는가?** 공급망이 다변화된 기업은 더 많은 유연성을 가질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **소조(sourcing)를 얼마나 빨리 전환할 수 있는가?** 생산을 옮기는 것은 느리고 비용이 많이 들므로 단기적인 구제는 제한적입니다.

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **경쟁사들도 가격을 올리고 있는가?** 라이벌들이 먼저 움직이면 다른 기업들도 따라가는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **소비자 수요는 어떻게 버티고 있는가?** 강력한 수요는 기업이 비용을 전가할 여지를 주지만, 약한 수요는 망설이게 만듭니다.

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## 가격 인상이 다가오고 있음을 알리는 신호

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: 모든 기업이 다르지만, 컨퍼런스 콜에서 나타나는 몇 가지 신호는 종종 소비자 가격 인상에 선행합니다:

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - **예상 마진을 낮추고** 그 원인을 무역 비용으로 돌리는 가이드라인.

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - 언어가 "흡수"에서 "부분적 상쇄" 또는 비용 "회수"로 바뀌는 것.

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - 다가오는 분기의 **정가 변경** 또는 "가격 실현"에 대한 언급.

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - **프로모션이 축소될 것**이라는 언급으로, 이는 쇼핑객이 지불하는 실질 가격을 조용히 끌어올립니다.

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - 동일한 가격에 **더 작은 패키지 크기 또는 더 적은 기능**에 대한 이야기로, 때로는 슈링크플레이션이라고 불립니다.

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## 가격이 안정적으로 유지될 수 있음을 알리는 신호

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: 다른 발언들은 그 반대 방향을 가리킵니다:

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - **비용 절감 프로그램**, 공급업체 양보, 또는 관세를 상쇄하는 새로운 조달 방식 강조.

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - 기업이 마진보다 **시장 점유율을 우선시하고 있다**는 진술.

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - 가격 인상을 더 위험하게 만드는 **수요 부진**의 증거.

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - 해당 카테고리에서 **경쟁이 여전히 치열하다**는 논평.

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 카테고리

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: 관세 노출도는 부문별로 매우 다양합니다.

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: 의류, 신발, 가전제품, 장난감, 가구, 가전기기, 자동차 부품과 같이 수입 완제품이나 부품에 크게 의존하는 기업들은 이러한 콜에서 할 말이 더 많은 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: 소매업체들도 공급업체 협상과 매장 가격의 균형을 어떻게 맞추고 있는지 논의하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: 국내 시장 중심의 서비스 기업들은 공급업체 비용을 통해 간접적인 영향을 여전히 느낄 수 있겠지만, 상대적으로 직접적인 노출은 적을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## 귀하가 지불하는 가격에 미칠 수 있는 의미

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: 기업이 한꺼번에 비용을 전가하는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: 더 전형적인 도로는 점진적입니다. 마진이 충격의 일부를 흡수하고, 특정 품목의 가격이 오르며, 그 후 프로모션이 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: 결과적으로 쇼핑객들은 극적인 가격표 변경을 보기 전에 더 적은 할인이나 완만한 인상을 알아차릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: 도움이 될 수 있는 실용적인 조치들:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: - 고액 구매 시 **소매업체 간 가격 비교**, 비용 전가는 판매자에 따라 다르기 때문입니다.

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **세일 주기에 주목.** 수입 노출도가 높은 카테고리에서는 계절별 프로모션이 덜 관대할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - 품질 차이가 작은 경우 **스토어 브랜드나 대안 고려**.

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - 분기마마다 가격이 변할 수 있으므로 가능하면 약간의 유연성을 가지고 **주요 구매 계획**.

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## 주의 사항

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: 실적 발표 콜은 미래지향적이며, 미래예측 진술은 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.
segments.tr: 무역에 대한 정책 결정이 바뀌고, 면제 조치가 부여되거나 철회될 수 있으며, 기업의 계획은 수요와 경쟁에 따라 진화할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Executives also have incentives to present their plans in the best light.
segments.tr: 임원들은 또한 자신의 계획을 가장 유리한 빛으로 포장할 유인을 가지고 있습니다.

segments.src: Treat any single comment as one data point and look for patterns across companies in the same industry.
segments.tr: 단일 논평은 하나의 데이터 포인트로 취급하고 동일 산업 내 기업들 간의 패턴을 찾으십시오.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Over the coming weeks, the tone and specifics of tariff discussions on earnings calls will offer one of the clearest windows into how trade costs are moving through the economy.
segments.tr: 앞으로 몇 주 동안 실적 발표 콜에서 이루어지는 관세 논의의 어조와 세부 사항은 무역 비용이 경제 속으로 어떻게 이동하고 있는지 보여주는 가장 명확한 창 중 하나를 제공할 것입니다.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether companies are absorbing, offsetting, or passing along costs, and to how confident they sound about customer demand.
segments.tr: 기업들이 비용을 흡수하고 있는지, 상쇄하고 있는지, 아니면 전가하고 있는지에 주목하고, 고객 수요에 대해 얼마나 자신감 있게 들리는지에 주목하십시오.

segments.src: Those details will go a long way toward explaining what prices may look like in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 그러한 세부 사항들은 다가오는 달에 가격이 어떤 모습일지 설명하는 데 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: Executives are being asked how much tariffs are costing them, how much of that cost they can absorb, and how much will eventually show up on price tags.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों से पूछा जा रहा है कि टैरिफ की उन्हें कितनी लागत आ रही है, वे उस लागत का कितना हिस्सा खुद उठा सकते हैं, और अंततः कितना मूल्य टैग पर दिखाई देगा।

segments.src: For consumers, these calls offer an early read on what may be coming to store shelves, showrooms, and online checkout pages.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ताओं के लिए, ये कॉल इस बात का शुरुआती संकेत देती हैं कि स्टोर की शेल्फ, शोरूम और ऑनलाइन चेकआउट पेजों पर क्या आने वाला है।

segments.src: This guide explains what to listen for, how to interpret common phrases, and what the answers could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: यह मार्गदर्शिका बताती है कि क्या सुनना है, आम वाक्यांशों की व्याख्या कैसे करें, और उत्तरों का घरेलू बजट के लिए क्या अर्थ हो सकता है।

segments.src: It is general information, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: यह सामान्य जानकारी है, निवेश या वित्तीय सलाह नहीं।

segments.src: ## Why earnings calls matter for the tariff story
segments.tr: ## टैरिफ की कहानी के लिए कमाई कॉल क्यों मायने रखती हैं

segments.src: Government trade data and economic reports tell us what is moving across borders.
segments.tr: सरकारी व्यापार डेटा और आर्थिक रिपोर्टें हमें बताती हैं कि सीमाओं के पार क्या जा रहा है।

segments.src: Earnings calls tell us what companies are actually doing about it.
segments.tr: आय कॉल हमें बताती हैं कि कंपनियां वास्तव में इसके बारे में क्या कर रही हैं।

segments.src: Every quarter, public companies discuss:
segments.tr: हर तिमाही, सार्वजनिक कंपनियां चर्चा करती हैं:

segments.src: - **Cost of goods sold:** how much it costs to make or buy what they sell.
segments.tr: - **बिक्री की गई वस्तुओं की लागत:** जो वे बेचते हैं उसे बनाने या खरीदने में कितना खर्च आता है।

segments.src: - **Gross margin:** the share of revenue left after those direct costs.
segments.tr: - **सकल मार्जिन:** उन प्रत्यक्ष लागतों के बाद बचा हुआ राजस्व का हिस्सा।

segments.src: - **Guidance:** what leadership expects for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: - **मार्गदर्शन:** आने वाली तिमाहियों के लिए नेतृत्व क्या उम्मीद करता है।

segments.src: - **Pricing actions:** whether, when, and by how much prices are rising.
segments.tr: - **मूल्य निर्धारण कार्रवाई:** कीमतें बढ़ रही हैं या नहीं, कब और कितने से।

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: चूंकि अधिकारियों को विश्लेषकों के सीधे सवालों का सामना करना पड़ता है, इसलिए ये कॉल अक्सर प्रेस विज्ञप्ति से ज्यादा खुलासा करती हैं, जिसमें यह भी शामिल है कि प्रबंधन को अपनी योजनाओं पर कितना भरोसा है।

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## मुख्य वाक्यांश और उनका आमतौर पर क्या अर्थ होता है

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: टैरिफ पर टिप्पणियां काफी अनुमानित शब्दावली में आती हैं।

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: यहाँ एक सरल भाषा में अनुवाद दिया गया है।

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **"हम प्रभाव को कम कर रहे हैं।"**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: कंपनी आपूर्तिकर्ता वार्ताओं, उत्पादों के स्रोत को बदलने, उत्पादों को फिर से डिजाइन करने, या अन्य लागतों में कटौती के माध्यम से झटके को कम करने की कोशिश कर रही है।

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब यह जरूरी नहीं है कि कीमतें स्थिर रहेंगी।

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **"हम लागत का एक हिस्सा वहन करने की उम्मीद करते हैं।"**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: लाभ मार्जिन फिलहाल कुछ दबाव झेलेगा।

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: अवशोषण आमतौर पर अस्थायी होता है, और शुल्क जितने लंबे समय तक लागू रहेंगे, उसे बनाए रखना उतना ही कठिन होगा।

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: हर उत्पाद की कीमत अधिक नहीं होगी।

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: कंपनियां अक्सर उन वस्तुओं की कीमतें बढ़ाती हैं जहां मांग मजबूत है, प्रतिस्पर्धा सीमित है, या टैरिफ का जोखिम सबसे अधिक है, जबकि मुख्य वस्तुओं या प्रचार वाली वस्तुओं पर स्थिर रखती हैं।

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **"सर्जिकल" या "लक्षित" मूल्य निर्धारण।**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: उपर्युक्त के समान।

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: व्यापक बढ़ोतरी के बजाय श्रेणी या ब्रांड के अनुसार बदलाव की अपेक्षा करें।

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"पुल-फॉरवर्ड" या "टैरिफ से पहले इन्वेंट्री"।**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: कंपनी ने शुल्क बढ़ने से पहले अतिरिक्त सामान खरीदा।

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: यह मूल्य परिवर्तनों में देरी कर सकता है, लेकिन एक बार जब वह कम लागत वाली इन्वेंट्री बिक जाती है, तो बाद की तिमाहियों में उच्च लागत दिखाई दे सकती है।

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: ग्राहक मूल्य परिवर्तनों के प्रति कितने संवेदनशील हैं।

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: जब अधिकारी लोच पर चर्चा करते हैं, तो वे तौल रहे हैं कि क्या खरीदार कीमतें बढ़ने पर कम कीमत वाले विकल्प चुनेंगे, खरीदारी में देरी करेंगे, या दूर चले जाएंगे।

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## विश्लेषक किस पर जोर देते हैं

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: उत्तरों के साथ-साथ प्रश्नों को भी सुनें।

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: पूछताछ की सामान्य पंक्तियों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **डॉलर्स में या मार्जिन के प्रतिशत अंकों में टैरिफ जोखिम कितना है?** विशिष्ट आंकड़े बताते हैं कि कंपनी ने विस्तृत योजना बनाई है; अस्पष्ट उत्तर अनिश्चितता का संकेत दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **प्रभावित देशों से उत्पादों या इनपुट का कितना हिस्सा आता है?** विविध आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं वाली कंपनियों के पास अधिक लचीलापन हो सकता है।

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **सोर्सिंग कितनी जल्दी स्थानांतरित हो सकती है?** उत्पादन स्थानांतरित करना धीमा और महंगा है, इसलिए निकट अवधि की राहत सीमित है।

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **क्या प्रतियोगी भी कीमतें बढ़ा रहे हैं?** यदि प्रतिद्वंद्वी पहले कदम उठाते हैं, तो अन्य लोग अक्सर उनका अनुसरण करते हैं।

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **उपभोक्ता की मांग कैसी बनी हुई है?** मजबूत मांग कंपनियों को लागत आगे बढ़ाने की गुंजाइश देती है; कमजोर मांग उन्हें झिझकने पर मजबूर करती है।

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## संकेत है कि मूल्य वृद्धि आ सकती है

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: जबकि हर व्यवसाय अलग है, कॉल पर कई संकेत अक्सर उच्च उपभोक्ता कीमतों से पहले आते हैं:

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - मार्गदर्शन जो **अपेक्षित मार्जिन को कम करता है** और इसे व्यापार लागत के लिए जिम्मेदार ठहराता है।

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - भाषा का "अवशोषित करने" से बदलकर "आंशिक रूप से ऑफसेट करने" या "वसूली" लागत करना।

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - आने वाली तिमाहियों में **सूची मूल्य परिवर्तनों** या "मूल्य प्राप्ति" का उल्लेख।

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - टिप्पणियां कि **प्रमोशन कम किए जाएंगे**, जो चुपचाप खरीदारों द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली प्रभावी कीमत को बढ़ाता है।

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - समान कीमत पर **छोटे पैकेज आकार या कम सुविधाओं** की बात, जिसे कभी-कभी श्रिंकफ्लेशन कहा जाता है।

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## संकेत है कि कीमतें स्थिर रह सकती हैं

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: अन्य टिप्पणियां विपरीत दिशा में इशारा करती हैं:

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - **लागत बचत कार्यक्रमों**, आपूर्तिकर्ता रियायतें, या नए सोर्सिंग पर जोर जो शुल्क की भरपाई करता है।

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - बयान कि कंपनी मार्जिन की तुलना में **বাজার শেয়ার (market share)** को प्राथमिकता दे रही है।

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - **कमजोर मांग** के सबूत, जो मूल्य वृद्धि को अधिक जोखिम भरा बनाते हैं।

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - टिप्पणी कि श्रेणी में **प्रतिस्पर्धा तीव्र बनी हुई है**।

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## किन श्रेणियों पर नजर रखनी चाहिए

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: टैरिफ जोखिम क्षेत्र के अनुसार काफी भिन्न होता है।

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: जो कंपनियां आयातित तैयार माल या घटकों पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करती हैं, जैसे कि परिधान, जूते, उपभोक्ता इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, खिलौने, फर्नीचर, उपकरण और ऑटो पार्ट्स, वे अक्सर इन कॉलों पर कहने के लिए अधिक रखती हैं।

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: खुदरा विक्रेता भी इस बात पर चर्चा करते हैं कि वे शेルフ की कीमतों के साथ विक्रेता वार्ताओं को कैसे संतुलित कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: घरेलू-केंद्रित सेवा व्यवसायों का प्रत्यक्ष जोखिम तुलनात्मक रूप से कम हो सकता है, हालांकि वे अभी भी आपूर्तिकर्ता लागत के माध्यम से अप्रत्यक्ष प्रभावों को महसूस कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## आपके द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली कीमतों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: कंपनियां शायद ही कभी एक बार में लागत आगे बढ़ाती हैं।

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: अधिक विशिष्ट मार्ग क्रमिक है: मार्जिन कुछ प्रभाव को अवशोषित करता है, फिर चुनिंदा वस्तुओं पर कीमतें बढ़ती हैं, फिर प्रमोशन कम होते हैं।

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: परिणामस्वरूप, खरीदार नाटकीय स्टिकर परिवर्तन देखने से पहले छोटी छूट या मामूली वृद्धि देख सकते हैं।

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: व्यावहारिक कदम जो मदद कर सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: बड़ी टिकट खरीद के लिए **खुदरा विक्रेताओं के बीच कीमतों की तुलना करें**, क्योंकि पास-थ्रू विक्रेता के अनुसार अलग-अलग होता है।

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **बिक्री चक्रों पर नजर रखें।** उच्च आयात जोखिम वाली श्रेणियों में मौसमी प्रचार कम उदार हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - **स्टोर ब्रांड या विकल्पों पर विचार करें** जहां गुणवत्ता का अंतर छोटा है।

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - यदि आप कर सकते हैं तो कुछ लचीलेपन के साथ **प्रमुख खरीदारी की योजना बनाएं**, क्योंकि कीमतें तिमाही-दर-तिमाही बदल सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## चेतावनी

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: कमाई कॉल दूर की दृष्टि वाली होती हैं, और दूर की दृष्टि वाले बयान बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.

es.title: Aranceles en las conferencias de resultados: lo que las empresas dicen a los inversores sobre costes y precios

segments.src: As third-quarter earnings season gets under way, one topic keeps surfacing in prepared remarks and analyst Q&A: import duties.
segments.tr: A medida que comienza la temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre, un tema sigue apareciendo en los comentarios preparados y en las preguntas y respuestas de los analistas: los aranceles a la importación.

segments.src: Executives are being asked how much tariffs are costing them, how much of that cost they can absorb, and how much will eventually show up on price tags.
segments.tr: A los directivos se les pregunta cuánto les cuestan los aranceles, cuánto de ese coste pueden absorber y cuánto terminará reflejándose en las etiquetas de precios.

segments.src: For consumers, these calls offer an early read on what may be coming to store shelves, showrooms, and online checkout pages.
segments.tr: Para los consumidores, estas llamadas ofrecen una lectura anticipada de lo que puede llegar a las estanterías de las tiendas, salas de exposición y páginas de pago en línea.

segments.src: This guide explains what to listen for, how to interpret common phrases, and what the answers could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica qué hay que escuchar, cómo interpretar las frases comunes y qué podrían significar las respuestas para los presupuestos familiares.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento de inversión o financiero.

segments.src: ## Why earnings calls matter for the tariff story
segments.tr: ## Por qué importan las conferencias de resultados para la historia de los aranceles

segments.src: Government trade data and economic reports tell us what is moving across borders.
segments.tr: Los datos comerciales del gobierno y los informes económicos nos dicen qué se mueve a través de las fronteras.

segments.src: Earnings calls tell us what companies are actually doing about it.
segments.tr: Las conferencias de resultados nos dicen qué están haciendo realmente las empresas al respecto.

segments.src: Every quarter, public companies discuss:
segments.tr: Cada trimestre, las empresas públicas analizan:

segments.src: - **Cost of goods sold:** how much it costs to make or buy what they sell.
segments.tr: - **Coste de los bienes vendidos:** cuánto cuesta fabricar o comprar lo que venden.

segments.src: - **Gross margin:** the share of revenue left after those direct costs.
segments.tr: - **Margen bruto:** la parte de los ingresos que queda después de esos costes directos.

segments.src: - **Guidance:** what leadership expects for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: - **Previsiones (Guidance):** lo que la dirección espera para los próximos trimestres.

segments.src: - **Pricing actions:** whether, when, and by how much prices are rising.
segments.tr: - **Acciones de precios:** si los precios están subiendo, cuándo y en qué medida.

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: Debido a que los directivos se enfrentan a preguntas directas de los analistas, las llamadas a menudo revelan más que un comunicado de prensa, incluida la confianza que tiene la dirección en sus propios planes.

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## Frases clave y lo que suelen significar

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: Los comentarios sobre aranceles tienden a utilizar un vocabulario bastante predecible.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: Aquí tienes una traducción en lenguaje sencillo.

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **"Estamos mitigando el impacto."**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: La empresa está intentando reducir el golpe mediante negociaciones con proveedores, cambiando el lugar de origen de los productos, rediseñando los productos o recortando otros costes.

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: No significa necesariamente que los precios vayan a mantenerse estables.

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **"Esperamos absorber una parte del coste."**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: Los márgenes de beneficio soportarán parte de la presión por ahora.

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: La absorción suele ser temporal, y cuanto más tiempo permanezcan los aranceles, más difícil será mantenerla.

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
segments.tr: **"Aumentos de precios selectivos."**

segments.src: Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: No todos los productos costarán más.

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: Las empresas suelen subir los precios en artículos donde la demanda es fuerte, la competencia es limitada o la exposición a los aranceles es mayor, mientras los mantienen estables en productos básicos o promocionales.

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **Precios "quirúrgicos" o "dirigidos".**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: Similar al punto anterior.

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: Espera cambios por categoría o marca en lugar de subidas generalizadas.

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"Adelanto" o "inventario antes de los aranceles."**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: La empresa compró productos adicionales antes de que subieran los aranceles.

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: Esto puede retrasar los cambios de precios, pero una vez que se venda ese inventario de menor coste, es posible que aparezcan costes más altos en trimestres posteriores.

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
segments.tr: **"Elasticidad."**

segments.src: How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: Cuán sensibles son los clientes a los cambios de precios.

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: Cuando los directivos hablan de elasticidad, están evaluando si los compradores buscarán alternativas más baratas, retrasarán sus compras o se marcharán si los precios suben.

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## En qué suelen insistir los analistas

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: Presta atención a las preguntas tanto como a las respuestas.

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: Las líneas de consulta comunes incluyen:

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **¿Cuál es la exposición a los aranceles, en dólares o puntos porcentuales de margen?** Las cifras específicas sugieren que una empresa ha hecho una planificación detallada; las respuestas vagas pueden indicar incertidumbre.

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **¿Qué porcentaje de productos o insumos provienen de países afectados?** Las empresas con cadenas de suministro diversificadas pueden tener mayor flexibilidad.

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **¿Con qué rapidez se puede cambiar el abastecimiento?** Trasladar la producción es lento y costoso, por lo que el alivio a corto plazo es limitado.

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **¿Los competidores también están subiendo los precios?** Si los rivales se mueven primero, los demás suelen seguirles.

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **¿Cómo se está manteniendo la demanda de los consumidores?** Una demanda fuerte da margen a las empresas para trasladar los costes; una demanda débil las hace dudar.

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## Señales de que los aumentos de precios pueden estar en camino

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: Aunque cada negocio es diferente, varias señales en una conferencia suelen preceder a precios al consumidor más altos:

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - Previsiones que **reducen los márgenes esperados** y los atribuyen a los costes comerciales.

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - Lenguaje que cambia de "absorber" a "compensar parcialmente" o "recuperar" costes.

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - Menciones de **cambios en los precios de lista** o "realización de precios" en los próximos trimestres.

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - Comentarios de que **se reducirán las promociones**, lo que eleva discretamente el precio efectivo que pagan los compradores.

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - Hablar de **tamaños de envase más pequeños o menos características** al mismo precio, a veces llamado reduflación.

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## Señales de que los precios pueden mantenerse estables

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: Otros comentarios apuntan en dirección contraria:

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - Énfasis en **programas de ahorro de costes**, concesiones de proveedores o nuevo abastecimiento que contrarresta los aranceles.

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - Declaraciones de que la empresa está **priorizando la cuota de mercado** por encima del margen.

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - Evidencia de **demanda floja**, lo que hace que las subidas de precios sean más arriesgadas.

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - Comentarios de que **la competencia sigue siendo intensa** en la categoría.

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## Qué categorías observar

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: La exposición a los aranceles varía ampliamente según el sector.

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: Las empresas que dependen en gran medida de productos terminados o componentes importados, como ropa, calzado, electrónica de consumo, juguetes, muebles, electrodomésticos y piezas de automóviles, a menudo tienen más que decir en estas llamadas.

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: Los minoristas también tienden a discutir cómo están equilibrando las negociaciones con los proveedores con los precios en las estanterías.

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: Las empresas de servicios centradas en el mercado nacional pueden tener una exposición directa comparativamente pequeña, aunque aún pueden sentir efectos indirectos a través de los costes de los proveedores.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## Qué podría significar para los precios que pagas

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: Las empresas rara vez trasladan los costes de golpe.

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: El camino más típico es gradual: los márgenes absorben parte del impacto, luego los precios suben en artículos seleccionados y después las promociones se reducen.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: Como resultado, los compradores pueden notar descuentos más pequeños o aumentos modestos antes de ver cambios drásticos en las etiquetas.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: Pasos prácticos que pueden ayudar:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: - **Compara precios entre minoristas** para compras costosas, ya que el traslado de costes varía según el vendedor.

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **Vigila los ciclos de rebajas.** Las promociones estacionales pueden ser menos generosas en categorías con alta exposición a las importaciones.

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - **Considera marcas blancas o alternativas** donde la diferencia de calidad sea pequeña.

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - **Planifica las compras importantes** con cierta flexibilidad si puedes, ya que los precios pueden cambiar de un trimestre a otro.

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## Las advertencias

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: Las conferencias de resultados miran hacia el futuro, y las declaraciones prospectivas pueden cambiar.

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.
segments.tr: Las decisiones políticas sobre comercio pueden cambiar, se pueden conceder o retirar exenciones, y los planes de las empresas pueden evolucionar con la demanda y la competencia.

segments.src: Executives also have incentives to present their plans in the best light.
segments.tr: Los directivos también tienen incentivos para presentar sus planes bajo la mejor luz posible.

segments.src: Treat any single comment as one data point and look for patterns across companies in the same industry.
segments.tr: Trata cualquier comentario individual como un único dato y busca patrones entre empresas de la misma industria.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: Over the coming weeks, the tone and specifics of tariff discussions on earnings calls will offer one of the clearest windows into how trade costs are moving through the economy.
segments.tr: Durante las próximas semanas, el tono y los detalles de los debates sobre aranceles en las conferencias de resultados ofrecerán una de las ventanas más claras sobre cómo los costes comerciales se están moviendo a través de la economía.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether companies are absorbing, offsetting, or passing along costs, and to how confident they sound about customer demand.
segments.tr: Presta atención a si las empresas están absorbiendo, compensando o trasladando los costes, y a la confianza con la que hablan sobre la demanda de los clientes.

segments.src: Those details will go a long way toward explaining what prices may look like in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Esos detalles servirán de mucho para explicar cómo podrían ser los precios en los próximos meses.

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: غالباً ما ترفع الشركات الأسعار على العناصر التي يكون الطلب عليها قوياً، أو المنافسة فيها محدودة، أو التي تكون معرضة للتعريفات الجمركية بشكل أكبر، مع الحفاظ على استقرار أسعار السلع الأساسية أو العناصر الترويجية.

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **تسعير "جراحي" أو "مستهدف".**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: مشابه لما سبق.

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: توقع تغييرات حسب الفئة أو العلامة التجارية بدلاً من زيادات شاملة.

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"السحب للأمام" أو "المخزون قبل التعريفات الجمركية."**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: اشترت الشركة بضائع إضافية قبل ارتفاع الرسوم.

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يؤدي هذا إلى تأخير تغييرات الأسعار، ولكن بمجرد بيع هذا المخزون منخفض التكلفة، قد تظهر تكاليف أعلى في الأرباع اللاحقة.

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
segments.tr: **"المرونة."**

segments.src: How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: مدى حساسية العملاء لتغيرات الأسعار.

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: عندما يناقش المسؤولون التنفيذيون المرونة، فإنهم يزنون ما إذا كان المتسوقون سيتحولون إلى بدائل أرخص، أو يؤجلون عمليات الشراء، أو يتراجعون عن الشراء إذا ارتفعت الأسعار.

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## ما يميل المحللون للضغط بشأنه

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: استمع للأسئلة بقدر استماعك للإجابات.

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: تشمل خطوط الاستفسار الشائعة ما يلي:

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **ما هو حجم التعرض للتعريفات الجمركية، بالدولار أو بنقاط مئوية من الهامش؟** تشير الأرقام المحددة إلى أن الشركة قامت بتخطيط مفصل؛ وقد تشير الإجابات الغامضة إلى عدم اليقين.

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **ما هي حصة المنتجات أو المدخلات التي تأتي من البلدان المتأثرة؟** قد تتمتع الشركات ذات سلاسل التوريد المتنوعة بمرونة أكبر.

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **ما مدى سرعة تحويل المصادر؟** نقل الإنتاج بطيء ومكلف، لذا فإن الإغاثة على المدى القريب محدودة.

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **هل يرفع المنافسون الأسعار أيضاً؟** إذا تحرك المنافسون أولاً، فغالباً ما يتبعهم الآخرون.

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **كيف يصمد طلب المستهلكين؟** الطلب القوي يمنح الشركات مجالاً لتمرير التكاليف؛ والطلب الضعيف يجعلها تتردد.

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## إشارات على أن زيادات الأسعار قد تكون قادمة

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: على الرغم من أن كل عمل تجاري مختلف، إلا أن العديد من الإشارات في المكالمة غالباً ما تسبق ارتفاع أسعار المستهلك:

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - التوجيهات التي **تخفض الهوامش المتوقعة** وتعزو ذلك إلى تكاليف التجارة.

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - تحول اللغة من "استيعاب" إلى "تعويض جزئي" أو "استرداد" التكاليف.

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - ذكر **تغييرات في قائمة الأسعار** أو "تحقيق السعر" في الأرباع القادمة.

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - تعليقات بأن **العروض الترويجية سيتم تقليلها**، مما يرفع بهدوء السعر الفعلي الذي يدفعه المتسوقون.

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - الحديث عن **أحجام عبوات أصغر أو ميزات أقل** بنفس السعر، وهو ما يسمى أحياناً تضخم الانكماش.

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## إشارات على أن الأسعار قد تظل ثابتة

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: تشير ملاحظات أخرى في الاتجاه المعاكس:

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - التركيز على **برامج توفير التكاليف**، أو تنازلات الموردين، أو مصادر جديدة تعوض الرسوم.

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - تصريحات بأن الشركة **تعطي الأولوية للحصة السوقية** على الهامش.

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - أدلة على **ضعف الطلب**، مما يجعل زيادات الأسعار أكثر خطورة.

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - تعليقات بأن **المنافسة لا تزال شديدة** في الفئة.

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## الفئات التي يجب مراقبتها

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: يختلف التعرض للتعريفات الجمركية بشكل كبير حسب القطاع.

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: الشركات التي تعتمد بشكل كبير على السلع النهائية المستوردة أو المكونات، مثل الملابس، والأحذية، والإلكترونيات الاستهلاكية، والألعاب، والأثاث، والأجهزة، وقطع غيار السيارات، غالباً ما يكون لديها المزيد لتقوله في هذه المكالمات.

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: يميل تجار التجزئة أيضاً إلى مناقشة كيفية موازنة مفاوضات البائعين مع أسعار الرفوف.

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: قد يكون لدى الشركات الخدمية التي تركز على السوق المحلي تعرض مباشر أقل نسبياً، على الرغم من أنها لا تزال تشعر بالتأثيرات غير المباشرة من خلال تكاليف الموردين.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن أن يعنيه ذلك بالنسبة للأسعار التي تدفعها

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: نادراً ما تمرر الشركات التكاليف دفعة واحدة.

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: المسار الأكثر شيوعاً هو التدريجي: تستوعب الهوامش بعض التأثير، ثم ترتفع الأسعار على عناصر مختارة، ثم تتضاءل العروض الترويجية.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: ونتيجة لذلك، قد يلاحظ المتسوقون خصومات أصغر أو زيادات متواضعة قبل أن يروا تغييرات دراماتيكية في الأسعار.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: خطوات عملية قد تساعد:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: - **قارن الأسعار بين تجار التجزئة** للمشتريات الكبيرة، حيث يختلف تمرير التكلفة حسب البائع.

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **راقب دورات التخفيضات.** قد تكون العروض الترويجية الموسمية أقل سخاء في الفئات ذات التعرض العالي للاستيراد.

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - **فكر في العلامات التجارية الخاصة بالمتاجر أو البدائل** حيث يكون فرق الجودة صغيراً.

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - **خطط للمشتريات الكبيرة** ببعض المرونة إذا استطعت، حيث يمكن أن تتغير الأسعار من ربع إلى آخر.

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## التحذيرات

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: مكالمات الأرباح تتطلع إلى المستقبل، والبيانات التطلعية يمكن أن تتغير.

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.
segments.tr: قد تتغير قرارات السياسة التجارية، وقد يتم منح إعفاءات أو إزالتها، ويمكن أن تتطور خطط الشركة مع الطلب والمنافسة.

segments.src: Executives also have incentives to present their plans in the best light.
segments.tr: لدى المسؤولين التنفيذيين أيضاً حوافز لتقديم خططهم في أفضل صورة.

segments.src: Treat any single comment as one data point and look for patterns across companies in the same industry.
segments.tr: تعامل مع أي تعليق فردي كنقطة بيانات واحدة وابحث عن أنماط عبر الشركات في نفس الصناعة.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Over the coming weeks, the tone and specifics of tariff discussions on earnings calls will offer one of the clearest windows into how trade costs are moving through the economy.
segments.tr: على مدى الأسابيع المقبلة، ستقدم نبرة وتفاصيل مناقشات التعريفات الجمركية في مكالمات الأرباح واحدة من أوضح النوافذ حول كيفية تحرك تكاليف التجارة عبر الاقتصاد.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether companies are absorbing, offsetting, or passing along costs, and to how confident they sound about customer demand.
segments.tr: انتبه إلى ما إذا كانت الشركات تستوعب التكاليف، أو تعوضها، أو تمررها، وإلى مدى ثقتها بشأن طلب العملاء.

segments.src: Those details will go a long way toward explaining what prices may look like in the months ahead.
segments.tr: ستقطع هذه التفاصيل شوطاً طويلاً نحو شرح كيف قد تبدو الأسعار في الأشهر المقبلة.

fr.title: Droits de douane lors des conférences téléphoniques sur les résultats : ce que les entreprises disent aux investisseurs sur les coûts et les prix

segments.src: As third-quarter earnings season gets under way, one topic keeps surfacing in prepared remarks and analyst Q&A: import duties.
segments.tr: Alors que la saison des résultats du troisième trimestre bat son plein, un sujet ne cesse de faire surface dans les déclarations préparées et les séances de questions-réponses avec les analystes : les droits de douane à l'importation.

segments.src: Executives are being asked how much tariffs are costing them, how much of that cost they can absorb, and how much will eventually show up on price tags.
segments.tr: On demande aux dirigeants combien les tarifs leur coûtent, quelle part de ce coût ils peuvent absorber et quelle part se retrouvera finalement sur les étiquettes de prix.

segments.src: For consumers, these calls offer an early read on what may be coming to store shelves, showrooms, and online checkout pages.
segments.tr: Pour les consommateurs, ces appels offrent un aperçu anticipé de ce qui pourrait arriver sur les rayons des magasins, dans les show-rooms et sur les pages de paiement en ligne.

segments.src: This guide explains what to listen for, how to interpret common phrases, and what the answers could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique quoi écouter, comment interpréter les expressions courantes et ce que les réponses pourraient signifier pour le budget des ménages.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales, et non de conseils en investissement ou financiers.

segments.src: ## Why earnings calls matter for the tariff story
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les appels sur les résultats comptent pour l'histoire des tarifs douaniers

segments.src: Government trade data and economic reports tell us what is moving across borders.
segments.tr: Les données du commerce gouvernemental et les rapports économiques nous disent ce qui traverse les frontières.

segments.src: Earnings calls tell us what companies are actually doing about it.
segments.tr: Les appels sur les résultats nous disent ce que les entreprises font réellement à ce sujet.

segments.src: Every quarter, public companies discuss:
segments.tr: Chaque trimestre, les sociétés cotées discutent de :

segments.src: - **Cost of goods sold:** how much it costs to make or buy what they sell.
segments.tr: - **Coût des marchandises vendues :** combien coûte la fabrication ou l'achat de ce qu'elles vendent.

segments.src: - **Gross margin:** the share of revenue left after those direct costs.
segments.tr: - **Marge brute :** la part du chiffre d'affaires restante après ces coûts directs.

segments.src: - **Guidance:** what leadership expects for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: - **Prévisions :** ce que la direction anticipe pour les trimestres à venir.

segments.src: - **Pricing actions:** whether, when, and by how much prices are rising.
segments.tr: - **Actions sur les prix :** si, quand et dans quelle mesure les prix augmentent.

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: Étant donné que les dirigeants font face aux questions directes des analystes, ces appels révèlent souvent plus qu'un communiqué de presse, y compris le degré de confiance du management dans ses propres plans.

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## Expressions clés et ce qu'elles signifient généralement

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: Les commentaires sur les tarifs douaniers ont tendance à utiliser un vocabulaire assez prévisible.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: Voici une traduction en langage clair.

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **"Nous atténuons l'impact."**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: L'entreprise essaie de réduire le choc par des négociations avec les fournisseurs, en changeant l'origine des produits, en reconcevant les produits ou en réduisant d'autres coûts.

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: Cela ne signifie pas nécessairement que les prix resteront stables.

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **"Nous prévoyons d'absorber une partie du coût."**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: Les marges bénéficiaires absorberont une partie de la pression pour l'instant.

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: L'absorption est généralement temporaire, et plus les droits restent en place, plus il est difficile de la maintenir.

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
segments.tr: **"Hausses de prix sélectives."**

segments.src: Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: Tous les produits ne coûteront pas plus cher.

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: Les entreprises augmentent souvent les prix des articles où la demande est forte, la concurrence est limitée ou l'exposition aux tarifs est la plus élevée, tout en maintenant les prix stables sur les produits de première nécessité ou promotionnels.

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **Tarification "chirurgicale" ou "ciblée".**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: Similaire à ce qui précède.

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: Attendez-vous à des changements par catégorie ou par marque plutôt qu'à des hausses généralisées.

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"Avancement" ou "constitution de stocks avant les tarifs".**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: L'entreprise a acheté des marchandises supplémentaires avant que les droits n'augmentent.

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: Cela peut retarder les changements de prix, mais une fois que cet inventaire à moindre coût sera écoulé, des coûts plus élevés pourront apparaître dans les trimestres suivants.

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
segments.tr: **"Élasticité."**

segments.src: How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: La sensibilité des clients aux variations de prix.

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: Lorsque les dirigeants discutent de l'élasticité, ils évaluent si les acheteurs se tourneront vers des produits moins chers, reporteront leurs achats ou renonceront à acheter si les prix augmentent.

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## Sur quoi les analystes insistent le plus

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: Prêtez attention aux questions autant qu'aux réponses.

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: Les axes d'interrogation courants incluent :

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **Quelle est l'exposition aux tarifs, en dollars ou en points de pourcentage de marge ?** Des chiffres précis suggèrent qu'une entreprise a fait une planification détaillée ; des réponses vagues peuvent signaler de l'incertitude.

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **Quelle proportion de produits ou d'intrants provient de pays touchés ?** Les entreprises ayant des chaînes d'approvisionnement diversifiées peuvent avoir plus de flexibilité.

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **À quelle vitesse l'approvisionnement peut-il changer ?** Déplacer la production est lent et coûteux, de sorte que le soulagement à court terme est limité.

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **Les concurrents augmentent-ils aussi leurs prix ?** Si les rivaux agissent en premier, les autres suivent souvent.

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **Comment se porte la demande des consommateurs ?** Une forte demande donne aux entreprises la marge de manœuvre nécessaire pour répercuter les coûts ; une faible demande les fait hésiter.

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## Signaux indiquant que des hausses de prix pourraient survenir

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: Bien que chaque entreprise soit différente, plusieurs signaux lors d'un appel précèdent souvent des prix à la consommation plus élevés :

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - Des prévisions qui **réduisent les marges attendues** et l'attribuent aux coûts commerciaux.

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - Un langage passant de "l'absorption" à "l'atténuation partielle" ou la "récupération" des coûts.

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - Des mentions de **changements de prix catalogués** ou de "réalisation des prix" dans les trimestres à venir.

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - Des commentaires selon lesquels **les promotions seront réduites**, ce qui augmente discrètement le prix effectif payé par les acheteurs.

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - Des discussions sur **des formats plus petits ou moins de fonctionnalités** au même prix, parfois appelé shrinkflation.

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## Signaux indiquant que les prix pourraient rester stables

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: D'autres remarques vont dans la direction opposée :

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - L'accent mis sur **les programmes de réduction des coûts**, les concessions des fournisseurs ou un nouvel approvisionnement qui compense les droits.

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - Des déclarations selon lesquelles l'entreprise **donne la priorité à la part de marché** plutôt qu'à la marge.

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - Des preuves d'une **demande molle**, ce qui rend les hausses de prix plus risquées.

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - Des commentaires selon lesquels **la concurrence reste intense** dans la catégorie.

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## Quelles catégories surveiller

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: L'exposition aux tarifs varie considérablement selon le secteur.

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: Les entreprises qui dépendent fortement de produits finis ou de composants importés, tels que l'habillement, la chaussure, l'électronique grand public, les jouets, les meubles, les appareils électroménagers et les pièces automobiles, ont souvent plus à dire lors de ces appels.

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: Les détaillants ont également tendance à discuter de la manière dont ils équilibrent les négociations avec les fournisseurs et les prix en rayon.

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: Les entreprises de services axées sur le marché intérieur peuvent avoir une exposition directe comparativement faible, bien qu'elles puissent encore ressentir des effets indirects par le biais des coûts des fournisseurs.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les prix que vous payez

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: Les entreprises répercutent rarement les coûts tous en même temps.

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: La voie la plus typique est graduelle : les marges absorbent une partie de l'impact, puis les prix augmentent sur certains articles, et enfin les promotions s'amenuisent.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: Par conséquent, les acheteurs peuvent remarquer des réductions plus faibles ou des augmentations modestes avant de voir des changements de prix spectaculaires.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: Mesures pratiques qui peuvent aider :

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: - **Comparer les prix entre les détaillants** pour les achats importants, car la répercussion varie selon le vendeur.

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **Surveiller les cycles de vente.** Les promotions saisonnières peuvent être moins généreuses dans les catégories à forte exposition aux importations.

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - **Envisager les marques de distributeur ou des alternatives** où la différence de qualité est minime.

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - **Planifier les achats importants** avec une certaine flexibilité si vous le pouvez, car les prix peuvent changer d'un trimestre à l'autre.

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## Les mises en garde

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: Les conférences sur les résultats sont prospectives, et les déclarations prospectives peuvent changer.

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.
segments.tr: Les décisions politiques en matière de commerce peuvent évoluer, des exemptions peuvent être accordées ou supprimées, et les plans des entreprises peuvent évoluer avec la demande et la concurrence.

segments.src: Executives also have incentives to present their plans in the best light.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants ont également des incitations à présenter leurs projets sous leur meilleur jour.

segments.src: Treat any single comment as one data point and look for patterns across companies in the same industry.
segments.tr: Traitez chaque commentaire individuel comme un point de données unique et recherchez des tendances parmi les entreprises de la même industrie.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: Over the coming weeks, the tone and specifics of tariff discussions on earnings calls will offer one of the clearest windows into how trade costs are moving through the economy.
segments.tr: Au cours des prochaines semaines, le ton et les spécificités des discussions sur les tarifs douaniers lors des appels de résultats offriront l'une des fenêtres les plus claires sur la façon dont les coûts commerciaux se propagent dans l'économie.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether companies are absorbing, offsetting, or passing along costs, and to how confident they sound about customer demand.
segments.tr: Faites attention à savoir si les entreprises absorbent, compensent ou répercutent les coûts, et au degré de confiance qu'elles affichent concernant la demande des clients.

segments.src: Those details will go a long way toward explaining what prices may look like in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Ces détails contribueront grandement à expliquer à quoi pourraient ressembler les prix dans les mois à venir.
