pt.title: Tarifas na Teleconferência de Resultados: O que as Empresas Estão Dizendo aos Investidores Sobre Custos e Preços

segments.src: As third-quarter earnings season gets under way, one topic keeps surfacing in prepared remarks and analyst Q&A: import duties.
segments.tr: À medida que a temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre se inicia, um tópico continua surgindo nas declarações preparadas e nas sessões de perguntas e respostas com analistas: as tarifas de importação.

segments.src: Executives are being asked how much tariffs are costing them, how much of that cost they can absorb, and how much will eventually show up on price tags.
segments.tr: Os executivos estão sendo questionados sobre quanto as tarifas lhes estão custando, quanto desse custo podem absorver e quanto eventualmente aparecerá nas etiquetas de preço.

segments.src: For consumers, these calls offer an early read on what may be coming to store shelves, showrooms, and online checkout pages.
segments.tr: Para os consumidores, essas chamadas oferecem uma leitura antecipada do que pode estar chegando às prateleiras das lojas, showrooms e páginas de checkout online.

segments.src: This guide explains what to listen for, how to interpret common phrases, and what the answers could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: Este guia explica o que procurar, como interpretar frases comuns e o que as respostas podem significar para os orçamentos domésticos.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: Trata-se de informação geral, não de consultoria financeira ou de investimentos.

segments.src: ## Why earnings calls matter for the tariff story
segments.tr: ## Por que as teleconferências de resultados importam para a história das tarifas

segments.src: Government trade data and economic reports tell us what is moving across borders.
segments.tr: Dados governamentais de comércio e relatórios econômicos nos dizem o que está cruzando as fronteiras.

segments.src: Earnings calls tell us what companies are actually doing about it.
segments.tr: As teleconferências de resultados nos dizem o que as empresas estão realmente fazendo a respeito.

segments.src: Every quarter, public companies discuss:
segments.tr: A cada trimestre, as empresas de capital aberto discutem:

segments.src: - **Cost of goods sold:** how much it costs to make or buy what they sell.
segments.tr: - **Custo dos produtos vendidos:** quanto custa fazer ou comprar o que elas vendem.

segments.src: - **Gross margin:** the share of revenue left after those direct costs.
segments.tr: - **Margem bruta:** a parcela da receita que sobra após esses custos diretos.

segments.src: - **Guidance:** what leadership expects for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: - **Projeções (Guidance):** o que a liderança espera para os próximos trimestres.

segments.src: - **Pricing actions:** whether, when, and by how much prices are rising.
segments.tr: - **Ações de preços:** se, quando e em que medida os preços estão subindo.

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: Como os executivos enfrentam perguntas diretas de analistas, as chamadas frequentemente revelam mais do que um comunicado à imprensa, incluindo o nível de confiança da gestão em seus próprios planos.

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## Frases-chave e o que elas geralmente significam

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: Os comentários sobre tarifas tendem a usar um vocabulário bastante previsível.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: Aqui está uma tradução em linguagem simples.

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **"Estamos mitigando o impacto."**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: A empresa está tentando reduzir o golpe por meio de negociações com fornecedores, mudança na origem dos produtos, redesign de produtos ou corte de outros custos.

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: Isso não significa necessariamente que os preços permanecerão estáveis.

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **"Esperamos absorver uma parcela do custo."**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: As margens de lucro suportarão parte da pressão por enquanto.

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: A absorção costuma ser temporária, e quanto mais tempo as tarifas permanecerem em vigor, mais difícil será sustentá-la.

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
segments.tr: **"Aumentos de preços seletivos."**

segments.src: Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: Nem todo produto custará mais caro.

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: As empresas frequentemente aumentam os preços em itens onde a demanda é forte, a concorrência é limitada ou a exposição tarifária é maior, mantendo a estabilidade em itens essenciais ou promocionais.

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **Preços "cirúrgicos" ou "direcionados".**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: Semelhante ao item anterior.

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: Espere mudanças por categoria ou marca, em vez de aumentos generalizados.

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"Antecipação de compras" ou "estoque antes das tarifas."**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: A empresa comprou produtos extras antes do aumento das tarifas.

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: Isso pode atrasar as mudanças de preço, mas, uma vez esgotado esse inventário de menor custo, custos mais altos podem aparecer em trimestres futuros.

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
segments.tr: **"Elasticidade."**

segments.src: How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: O quão sensíveis os clientes são às mudanças de preço.

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: Quando os executivos discutem elasticidade, estão avaliando se os compradores optarão por produtos mais baratos, adiarão compras ou desistirão caso os preços subam.

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## Onde os analistas tendem a pressionar

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: Preste tanta atenção nas perguntas quanto nas respostas.

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: Linhas comuns de investigação incluem:

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **Qual é a exposição tarifária, em dólares ou pontos percentuais de margem?** Figuras específicas sugerem que a empresa fez um planejamento detalhado; respostas vagas podem sinalizar incerteza.

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **Qual fatia de produtos ou insumos vem de países afetados?** Empresas com cadeias de suprimentos diversificadas podem ter mais flexibilidade.

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **Com que rapidez a origem dos insumos pode mudar?** Mover a produção é lento e caro, portanto o alívio a curto prazo é limitado.

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **Os concorrentes também estão subindo os preços?** Se os rivais agem primeiro, os outros frequentemente seguem.

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **Como a demanda do consumidor está se mantendo?** Uma demanda forte dá às empresas margem para repassar os custos; uma demanda fraca as faz hesitar.

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## Sinais de que aumentos de preços podem estar a caminho

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: Embora cada negócio seja diferente, vários sinais em uma chamada frequentemente precedem preços mais altos ao consumidor:

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - Projeções que **reduzem as margens esperadas** e atribuem isso aos custos comerciais.

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - Linguagem mudando de "absorção" para "compensação parcial" ou "recuperação" de custos.

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - Menções a **mudanças nos preços de tabela** ou "realização de preços" nos próximos trimestres.

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - Comentários de que **as promoções serão reduzidas**, o que eleva silenciosamente o preço efetivo pago pelos compradores.

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - Conversas sobre **embalagens menores ou menos recursos** pelo mesmo preço, às vezes chamado de reduflação.

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## Sinais de que os preços podem permanecer estáveis

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: Outros comentários apontam na direção oposta:

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - Ênfase em **programas de redução de custos**, concessões de fornecedores ou nova origem de suprimentos que compensem as tarifas.

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - Declarações de que a empresa está **priorizando a participação de mercado** em detrimento da margem.

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - Evidências de **demanda fraca**, o que torna os aumentos de preços mais arriscados.

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - Comentários de que **a concorrência permanece intensa** na categoria.

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## Quais categorias observar

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: A exposição às tarifas varia amplamente por setor.

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: Empresas que dependem fortemente de produtos acabados ou componentes importados, como vestuário, calçados, eletrônicos de consumo, brinquedos, móveis, eletrodomésticos e autopeças, frequentemente têm mais a dizer nessas chamadas.

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: Os varejistas também tendem a discutir como estão equilibrando as negociações com fornecedores e os preços nas prateleiras.

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: Empresas de serviços voltadas para o mercado doméstico podem ter uma exposição direta comparativamente pequena, embora ainda possam sentir efeitos indiretos por meio dos custos dos fornecedores.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## O que isso pode significar para os preços que você paga

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: As empresas raramente repassam os custos de uma só vez.

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: O caminho mais típico é gradual: as margens absorvem parte do impacto, depois os preços sobem em itens selecionados e, em seguida, as promoções diminuem.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: Como resultado, os compradores podem notar descontos menores ou aumentos modestos antes de verem mudanças drásticas nas etiquetas.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: Passos práticos que podem ajudar:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: - **Compare preços entre varejistas** para compras de alto valor, já que o repasse varia por vendedor.

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **Fique atento aos ciclos de vendas.** Promoções sazonais podem ser menos generosas em categorias com alta exposição a importações.

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - **Considere marcas próprias ou alternativas** onde a diferença de qualidade seja pequena.

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - **Planeje compras importantes** com alguma flexibilidade, se puder, já que os preços podem mudar de trimestre para trimestre.

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## As ressalvas

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: As teleconferências de resultados são voltadas para o futuro, e declarações prospectivas podem mudar.

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.
segments.tr: Decisões políticas sobre o comércio podem mudar, isenções podem ser concedidas ou removidas, e os planos das empresas podem evoluir com a demanda e a concorrência.

segments.src: Executives also have incentives to present their plans in the best light.
segments.tr: Os executivos também têm incentivos para apresentar seus planos da melhor forma possível.

segments.src: Treat any single comment as one data point and look for patterns across companies in the same industry.
segments.tr: Trate qualquer comentário isolado como um único ponto de dados e procure padrões entre empresas do mesmo setor.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: Over the coming weeks, the tone and specifics of tariff discussions on earnings calls will offer one of the clearest windows into how trade costs are moving through the economy.
segments.tr: Nas próximas semanas, o tom e os detalhes das discussões sobre tarifas nas teleconferências de resultados oferecerão uma das janelas mais claras sobre como os custos comerciais estão se movimentando na economia.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether companies are absorbing, offsetting, or passing along costs, and to how confident they sound about customer demand.
segments.tr: Preste atenção se as empresas estão absorvendo, compensando ou repassando custos, e em quão confiantes elas parecem sobre a demanda do consumidor.

segments.src: Those details will go a long way toward explaining what prices may look like in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Esses detalhes ajudarão muito a explicar como serão os preços nos próximos meses.

segments.tr: *Este artigo tem fins estritamente informativos e não constitui consultoria de investimentos, tributária ou financeira.*

segments.src: ## Why earnings calls matter for the tariff story
segments.tr: ## Mengapa panggilan pendapatan penting untuk cerita tarif

segments.src: Government trade data and economic reports tell us what is moving across borders.
segments.tr: Data perdagangan pemerintah dan laporan ekonomi memberi tahu kita apa yang bergerak melintasi perbatasan.

segments.src: Earnings calls tell us what companies are actually doing about it.
segments.tr: Panggilan pendapatan memberi tahu kita apa yang sebenarnya dilakukan perusahaan terkait hal tersebut.

segments.src: Every quarter, public companies discuss:

segments.src: - **Cost of goods sold:** how much it costs to make or buy what they sell.
segments.tr: - **Harga pokok penjualan:** berapa biaya untuk membuat atau membeli apa yang mereka jual.

segments.src: - **Gross margin:** the share of revenue left after those direct costs.
segments.tr: - **Margin kotor:** bagian pendapatan yang tersisa setelah biaya langsung tersebut.

segments.src: - **Guidance:** what leadership expects for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: - **Panduan:** apa yang diharapkan pimpinan untuk kuartal mendatang.

segments.src: - **Pricing actions:** whether, when, and by how much prices are rising.

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: Karena para eksekutif menghadapi pertanyaan langsung dari analis, panggilan tersebut sering kali mengungkapkan lebih banyak daripada siaran pers, termasuk seberapa yakin manajemen terhadap rencananya sendiri.

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## Frasa kunci dan apa artinya biasanya

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: Komentar mengenai tarif cenderung menggunakan kosakata yang cukup mudah ditebak.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: Berikut adalah terjemahan dalam bahasa yang sederhana.

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **"Kami sedang memitigasi dampaknya."**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: Perusahaan mencoba mengurangi dampak melalui negosiasi pemasok, mengubah sumber produk, mendesain ulang produk, atau memotong biaya lainnya.

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: Itu tidak berarti harga akan tetap datar.

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **"Kami berharap dapat menyerap sebagian dari biaya tersebut."**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: Margin keuntungan akan menanggung sebagian tekanan untuk saat ini.

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: Penyerapan biasanya bersifat sementara, dan semakin lama bea tetap berlaku, semakin sulit untuk dipertahankan.

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
segments.tr: **"Kenaikan harga selektif."**

segments.src: Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: Tidak semua produk akan menjadi lebih mahal.

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: Perusahaan sering kali menaikkan harga pada barang-barang yang permintaannya kuat, persaingannya terbatas, atau paparan tarifnya paling tinggi, sementara tetap mempertahankan harga pada barang kebutuhan pokok atau barang promosi.

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **"Bedah" atau "tertarget" penetapan harga.**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: Mirip dengan di atas.

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: Harapkan perubahan berdasarkan kategori atau merek daripada kenaikan menyeluruh.

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"Penarikan ke depan" atau "inventaris sebelum tarif."**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: Perusahaan membeli barang tambahan sebelum bea naik.

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: Ini dapat menunda perubahan harga, tetapi setelah inventaris berbiaya lebih rendah itu terjual habis, biaya yang lebih tinggi mungkin muncul di kuartal berikutnya.

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
segments.tr: **"Elastisitas."**

segments.src: How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: Seberapa sensitif pelanggan terhadap perubahan harga.

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: Ketika eksekutif mendiskusikan elastisitas, mereka mempertimbangkan apakah pembeli akan beralih ke produk yang lebih murah, menunda pembelian, atau pergi jika harga naik.

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## Apa yang cenderung ditekan oleh analis

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: Dengarkan pertanyaannya sama seperti jawabannya.

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: Garis pertanyaan umum meliputi:

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **Berapa paparan tarifnya, dalam dolar atau poin persentase margin?** Angka spesifik menunjukkan perusahaan telah melakukan perencanaan terperinci; jawaban yang samar mungkin menandakan ketidakpastian.

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **Berapa bagian produk atau input yang berasal dari negara yang terdampak?** Perusahaan dengan rantai pasokan yang terdiversifikasi mungkin memiliki fleksibilitas lebih.

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **Seberapa cepat sumber dapat dialihkan?** Memindahkan produksi itu lambat dan mahal, jadi bantuan jangka pendek terbatas.

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **Apakah pesaing juga menaikkan harga?** Jika pesaing bergerak lebih dulu, yang lain sering mengikuti.

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **Bagaimana permintaan konsumen bertahan?** Permintaan yang kuat memberi perusahaan ruang untuk meneruskan biaya; permintaan yang lemah membuat mereka ragu.

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## Sinyal bahwa kenaikan harga mungkin akan datang

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: Meskipun setiap bisnis berbeda, beberapa sinyal dalam panggilan sering kali mendahului harga konsumen yang lebih tinggi:

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - Panduan yang **menurunkan margin yang diharapkan** dan mengaitkannya dengan biaya perdagangan.

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - Bahasa beralih dari "menyerap" menjadi "mengimbangi sebagian" atau "memulihkan" biaya.

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - Penyebutan **perubahan harga daftar** atau "realisasi harga" di kuartal mendatang.

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - Komentar bahwa **promosi akan dikurangi**, yang secara diam-diam menaikkan harga efektif yang dibayar pembeli.

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - Pembicaraan tentang **ukuran paket yang lebih kecil atau fitur yang lebih sedikit** dengan harga yang sama, terkadang disebut shrinkflation.

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## Sinyal bahwa harga mungkin tetap stabil

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: Pernyataan lain menunjukkan arah yang berlawanan:

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - Penekanan pada **program penghematan biaya**, konsesi pemasok, atau sumber baru yang mengimbangi bea.

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - Pernyataan bahwa perusahaan **memprioritaskan pangsa pasar** di atas margin.

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - Bukti **permintaan yang lemah**, yang membuat kenaikan harga lebih berisiko.

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - Komentar bahwa **persaingan tetap ketat** dalam kategori tersebut.

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## Kategori mana yang harus diperhatikan

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: Paparan tarif sangat bervariasi menurut sektor.

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: Perusahaan yang sangat bergantung pada barang jadi atau komponen impor, seperti pakaian, alas kaki, elektronik konsumen, mainan, furnitur, peralatan, dan suku cadang mobil, sering kali memiliki lebih banyak hal untuk dikatakan dalam panggilan ini.

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: Pengecer juga cenderung mendiskusikan bagaimana mereka menyeimbangkan negosiasi vendor dengan harga rak.

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: Bisnis jasa yang berfokus pada domestik mungkin memiliki paparan langsung yang relatif kecil, meskipun mereka masih dapat merasakan efek tidak langsung melalui biaya pemasok.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi harga yang Anda bayar

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: Perusahaan jarang meneruskan biaya sekaligus.

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: Jalur yang lebih umum adalah bertahap: margin menyerap sebagian dampak, kemudian harga naik pada barang-barang tertentu, kemudian promosi berkurang.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: Akibatnya, pembeli mungkin melihat diskon yang lebih kecil atau kenaikan moderat sebelum mereka melihat perubahan harga yang drastis.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: Langkah praktis yang mungkin membantu:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan harga antar pengecer** untuk pembelian barang besar, karena penerusan biaya bervariasi menurut penjual.

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **Perhatikan siklus penjualan.** Promosi musiman mungkin kurang murah hati dalam kategori dengan paparan impor yang tinggi.

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - **Pertimbangkan merek toko atau alternatif** di mana perbedaan kualitasnya kecil.

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - **Rencanakan pembelian besar** dengan fleksibilitas jika Anda bisa, karena harga dapat berubah dari kuartal ke kuartal.

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## Peringatan

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: Panggilan pendapatan berorientasi ke depan, dan pernyataan berorientasi ke depan dapat berubah.

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.
segments.tr: Keputusan kebijakan tentang perdagangan dapat berubah, pengecualian dapat diberikan atau dihapus, dan rencana perusahaan dapat berkembang seiring dengan permintaan dan persaingan.

segments.src: Executives also have incentives to present their plans in the best light.
segments.tr: Eksekutif juga memiliki insentif untuk menyajikan rencana mereka dalam sudut pandang terbaik.

segments.src: Treat any single comment as one data point and look for patterns across companies in the same industry.
segments.tr: Perlakukan komentar tunggal apa pun sebagai satu titik data dan cari pola di seluruh perusahaan dalam industri yang sama.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Over the coming weeks, the tone and specifics of tariff discussions on earnings calls will offer one of the clearest windows into how trade costs are moving through the economy.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa minggu mendatang, nada dan rincian diskusi tarif pada panggilan pendapatan akan menawarkan salah satu jendela paling jelas tentang bagaimana biaya perdagangan bergerak melalui ekonomi.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether companies are absorbing, offsetting, or passing along costs, and to how confident they sound about customer demand.
segments.tr: Perhatikan apakah perusahaan menyerap, mengimbangi, atau meneruskan biaya, dan seberapa yakin mereka tentang permintaan pelanggan.

segments.src: Those details will go a long way toward explaining what prices may look like in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Rincian tersebut akan sangat membantu dalam menjelaskan seperti apa harga di bulan-bulan mendatang.

ja.title: 決算説明会における関税：企業がコストと価格について投資家に伝えていること

segments.src: As third-quarter earnings season gets under way, one topic keeps surfacing in prepared remarks and analyst Q&A: import duties.
segments.tr: 第3四半期の決算シーズンが本格化するにつれ、用意された発言やアナリストとの質疑応答で繰り返し浮上するトピックが1つあります。それは輸入関税です。

segments.src: Executives are being asked how much tariffs are costing them, how much of that cost they can absorb, and how much will eventually show up on price tags.
segments.tr: 経営陣は、関税にどれだけのコストがかかっているか、そのコストのうちどれだけを吸収できるか、そしてどれだけが最終的に値札に反映されるかについて質問を受けています。

segments.src: For consumers, these calls offer an early read on what may be coming to store shelves, showrooms, and online checkout pages.
segments.tr: 消費者にとって、これらの電話会議は、店頭、ショールーム、オンラインのチェックアウトページに何がやってくるかをいち早く知る手がかりとなります。

segments.src: This guide explains what to listen for, how to interpret common phrases, and what the answers could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: このガイドでは、何に耳を傾けるべきか、一般的な表現をどう解釈するか、そしてその回答が家計にどのような意味を持つかについて説明します。

segments.src: It is general information, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: これは一般的な情報であり、投資や財務に関するアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: ## Why earnings calls matter for the tariff story
segments.tr: ## 関税の話題において決算説明会が重要な理由

segments.src: Government trade data and economic reports tell us what is moving across borders.
segments.tr: 政府の貿易データや経済レポートは、国境を越えて何が動いているかを教えてくれます。

segments.src: Earnings calls tell us what companies are actually doing about it.
segments.tr: 決算説明会は、企業がそれに対して実際に何をしているかを教えてくれます。

segments.src: Every quarter, public companies discuss:
segments.tr: 上場企業は毎四半期、次の項目について議論します。

segments.src: - **Cost of goods sold:** how much it costs to make or buy what they sell.
segments.tr: - **売上原価:** 販売するものを製造または購入するのにかかる費用。

segments.src: - **Gross margin:** the share of revenue left after those direct costs.
segments.tr: - **売上総利益率:** それらの直接費用の後に残る収益の割合。

segments.src: - **Guidance:** what leadership expects for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: - **業績予想（ガイダンス）:** 経営陣が今後の四半期に何を期待しているか。

segments.src: - **Pricing actions:** whether, when, and by how much prices are rising.
segments.tr: - **価格設定のアクション:** 価格が上昇するかどうか、いつ、どれだけ上昇するか。

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: 経営陣はアナリストからの直接的な質問に直面するため、決算説明会は、経営陣自身の計画に対する自信の度合いを含め、プレスリリースよりも多くのことを明らかにすることがよくあります。

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## 主なフレーズとその一般的な意味

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: 関税に関するコメントは、かなり予測可能な語彙で行われる傾向があります。

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: 以下にわかりやすい言葉で翻訳します。

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **「我々は影響を緩和している。」**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: 企業は、サプライヤーとの交渉、調達先の変更、製品の再設計、またはその他のコスト削減を通じて、打撃を軽減しようとしています。

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: それは必ずしも価格が据え置きになることを意味するわけではありません。

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **「コストの一部を吸収する予定です。」**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: 当面の間、利益率がプレッシャーの一部を担うことになります。

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: 吸収は通常一時的なものであり、関税が課され続ける期間が長くなるほど、それを維持することは難しくなります。

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
segments.tr: **「選択的な値上げ。」**

segments.src: Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: すべての製品の価格が上がるわけではありません。

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: 企業は、需要が強く、競争が限られており、関税の影響が最も大きい品目の価格を引き上げる一方で、日用品やプロモーション品については据え置くことがよくあります。

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **「外科的」または「ターゲットを絞った」価格設定。**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: 上記と同様です。

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: 一律の値上げではなく、カテゴリーやブランドごとの変更が予想されます。

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **「前倒し購入」または「関税前の在庫確保」。**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: 企業は関税が引き上げられる前に余分な商品を購入しました。

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: これにより価格変更を遅らせることができますが、その低コストの在庫が売り切れると、後の四半期でコスト高が現れる可能性があります。

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
segments.tr: **「価格弾力性。」**

segments.src: How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: 顧客が価格の変化に対してどれほど敏感であるか。

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: 経営陣が弾力性について議論するとき、彼らは、価格が上昇した場合に買い手がより安価な商品に乗り換えるか、購入を遅らせるか、あるいは去っていくかを検討しています。

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## アナリストが追及する傾向がある点

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: 答えと同じくらい質問に耳を傾けてください。

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: 一般的な質問の路線には次のようなものがあります。

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **ドル換算または利益率のパーセンテージでの関税影響額はどれくらいですか？** 具体的な数字は企業が詳細な計画を立てていることを示唆し、あいまいな答えは不確実性を示している可能性があります。

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **製品や投入財の何割が影響を受けた国からのものですか？** サプライチェーンが多様化している企業は、より多くの柔軟性を持っている可能性があります。

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **調達先はどれくらい早く切り替えられますか？** 生産拠点の移動は遅く費用がかかるため、短期的な救済は限られています。

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **競合他社も値上げしていますか？** ライバルが最初に動けば、他の企業もそれに続くことがよくあります。

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **消費者の需要はどう持ちこたえていますか？** 需要が強ければ企業はコストを転嫁する余裕ができ、需要が弱ければ躊躇します。

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## 値上げが近づいている可能性を示すシグナル

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: 企業によって異なりますが、電話会議でのいくつかのシグナルは、多くの場合、消費者物価の上昇に先行します。

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - **予想利益率を引き下げる**ガイダンスとその原因を貿易コストに帰属させること。

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - 言葉が「吸収する」から「部分的に相殺する」または「回収する」へと変化すること。

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - 今後の四半期における**定価の変更**や「価格の実現」への言及。

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - **プロモーションが削減される**というコメント。これにより、買い物客が支払う実質的な価格がひそかに上昇します。

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - 同じ価格で**パッケージサイズが小さくなったり、機能が減ったりする**という話（シュリンクフレーションと呼ばれることもあります）。

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## 価格が据え置きになる可能性を示すシグナル

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: 他の発言は逆の方向を指しています。

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - **コスト削減プログラム**、サプライヤーからの譲歩、または関税を相殺する新しい調達への強調。

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - 企業が利益率よりも**市場シェアを優先している**という発言。

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - **軟調な需要**の証拠。これにより値上げのリスクが高まります。

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - そのカテゴリーにおいて**競争が激しいままである**という解説。

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## 注目すべきカテゴリー

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: 関税の影響はセクターによって大きく異なります。

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: アパレル、フットウェア、家電製品、おもちゃ、家具、家電、自動車部品など、輸入完成品や部品に大きく依存している企業は、これらの電話会議で語ることが多くなります。

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: 小売業者も、ベンダーとの交渉と店頭価格のバランスをどのように取っているかについて議論する傾向があります。

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## あなたが支払う価格にとってそれが意味すること

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.

de.title: Zölle in der Telefonkonferenz zum Quartalsergebnis: Was Unternehmen Investoren über Kosten und Preise mitteilen

segments.src: As third-quarter earnings season gets under way, one topic keeps surfacing in prepared remarks and analyst Q&A: import duties.
segments.tr: Zu Beginn der Berichtssaison für das dritte Quartal taucht ein Thema in vorbereiteten Erklärungen und Fragen und Antworten von Analysten immer wieder auf: Importzölle.

segments.src: Executives are being asked how much tariffs are costing them, how much of that cost they can absorb, and how much will eventually show up on price tags.
segments.tr: Führungskräfte werden gefragt, wie viel sie die Zölle kosten, wie viel dieser Kosten sie absorbieren können und wie viel schließlich auf Preisschildern auftauchen wird.

segments.src: For consumers, these calls offer an early read on what may be coming to store shelves, showrooms, and online checkout pages.
segments.tr: Für Verbraucher bieten diese Gespräche einen frühen Einblick in das, was möglicherweise auf sie in Regalen, Ausstellungsräumen und Online-Kassen zukommt.

segments.src: This guide explains what to listen for, how to interpret common phrases, and what the answers could mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden erklärt, worauf zu achten ist, wie gängige Ausdrücke zu interpretieren sind und was die Antworten für Haushaltsbudgets bedeuten könnten.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment or financial advice.
segments.tr: Es handelt sich um allgemeine Informationen, nicht um Anlage- oder Finanzberatung.

segments.src: ## Why earnings calls matter for the tariff story
segments.tr: ## Warum Telefonkonferenzen zu Quartalsergebnissen für das Zolldrama wichtig sind

segments.src: Government trade data and economic reports tell us what is moving across borders.
segments.tr: Regierungsbezogene Handelsdaten und Wirtschaftsberichte zeigen uns, was über Grenzen hinweg bewegt wird.

segments.src: Earnings calls tell us what companies are actually doing about it.
segments.tr: Konferenzschaltungen zu Ergebnissen zeigen uns, was Unternehmen tatsächlich dagegen tun.

segments.src: Every quarter, public companies discuss:
segments.tr: Jedes Quartal diskutieren börsennotierte Unternehmen über:

segments.src: - **Cost of goods sold:** how much it costs to make or buy what they sell.
segments.tr: - **Cost of goods sold:** wie viel es kostet, das zu produzieren oder zu kaufen, was sie verkaufen.

segments.src: - **Gross margin:** the share of revenue left after those direct costs.
segments.tr: - **Gross margin:** der Anteil des Umsatzes, der nach diesen direkten Kosten übrig bleibt.

segments.src: - **Guidance:** what leadership expects for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: - **Guidance:** was die Führung für die kommenden Quartale erwartet.

segments.src: - **Pricing actions:** whether, when, and by how much prices are rising.
segments.tr: - **Pricing actions:** ob, wann und um wie viel die Preise steigen.

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: Da Führungskräfte direkten Fragen von Analysten ausgesetzt sind, enthüllen die Gespräche oft mehr als eine Pressemitteilung, einschließlich der Frage, wie zuversichtlich das Management in seine eigenen Pläne ist.

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## Wichtige Ausdrücke und was sie normalerweise bedeuten

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: Die Zollkommentare neigen dazu, ein ziemlich vorhersehbares Vokabular zu verwenden.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: Hier ist eine Übersetzung in einfache Sprache.

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **"We are mitigating the impact."**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: Das Unternehmen versucht, den Schlag durch Lieferantenverhandlungen, Änderungen der Beschaffungsquellen, Produktdesignänderungen oder Kostensenkungen zu verringern.

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: Das bedeutet nicht unbedingt, dass die Preise stabil bleiben.

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: Gewinnmargen werden vorerst einen Teil des Drucks abfedern.

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: Die Absorption ist in der Regel vorübergehend, und je länger Zölle bestehen bleiben, desto schwieriger ist sie aufrechtzuerhalten.

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
segments.tr: **"Selective price increases."**

segments.src: Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: Nicht jedes Produkt wird teurer werden.

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: Unternehmen erhöhen häufig die Preise für Artikel, bei denen die Nachfrage stark ist, der Wettbewerb begrenzt ist oder das Zollrisiko am höchsten ist, während sie bei Grundnahrungsmitteln oder Werbeartikeln stabil bleiben.

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **"Surgical" oder "targeted" pricing.**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: Ähnlich wie oben.

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: Erwarten Sie Änderungen nach Kategorie oder Marke anstelle von flächendeckenden Erhöhungen.

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"Pull-forward" oder "inventory ahead of tariffs."**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: Das Unternehmen kaufte zusätzliche Waren, bevor die Zölle stiegen.

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: Dies kann Preisänderungen verzögern, aber sobald dieser kostengünstigere Bestand abverkauft ist, können in späteren Quartalen höhere Kosten auftreten.

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
segments.tr: **"Elasticity."**

segments.src: How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: Wie empfindlich Kunden auf Preisänderungen reagieren.

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: Wenn Führungskräfte Elastizität diskutieren, wägen sie ab, ob Käufer auf günstigere Alternativen ausweichen, Käufe verschieben oder sich abwenden, wenn die Preise steigen.

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## Worauf Analysten drängen

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: Achten Sie auf die Fragen genauso wie auf die Antworten.

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: Gängige Untersuchungslinien umfassen:

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **Wie hoch ist die Zollbelastung in Dollar oder Prozentpunkten der Marge?** Spezifische Zahlen deuten darauf hin, dass ein Unternehmen detaillierte Planungen durchgeführt hat; vage Antworten können Unsicherheit signalisieren.

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **Welcher Anteil an Produkten oder Vorleistungen stammt aus betroffenen Ländern?** Unternehmen mit diversifizierten Lieferketten haben möglicherweise mehr Flexibilität.

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **Wie schnell kann die Beschaffung verlagert werden?** Die Verlagerung der Produktion ist langsam und teuer, sodass die kurzfristige Entlastung begrenzt ist.

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **Erhöhen die Wettbewerber auch die Preise?** Wenn Konkurrenten zuerst handeln, folgen andere oft.

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **Wie hält sich die Verbrauchernachfrage?** Eine starke Nachfrage gibt Unternehmen Raum, Kosten weiterzugeben; eine schwache Nachfrage lässt sie zögern.

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## Signale, dass Preiserhöhungen bevorstehen könnten

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: Obwohl jedes Unternehmen anders ist, gehen höheren Verbraucherpreisen in einer Telefonkonferenz oft mehrere Signale voraus:

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - Eine Guidance, die **die erwarteten Margen senkt** und dies auf Handelskosten zurückführt.

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - Sprache, die sich von "absorbierend" zu "teilweise ausgleichend" oder "wiederherstellend" von Kosten verschiebt.

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - Erwähnungen von **Listenpreisänderungen** oder "Preisrealisierung" in den kommenden Quartalen.

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - Kommentare, dass **Werbeaktionen reduziert werden**, was den effektiven Preis, den Käufer zahlen, unauffällig erhöht.

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - Rede von **kleineren Packungsgrößen oder weniger Funktionen** zum gleichen Preis, manchmal auch Shrinkflation genannt.

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## Signale, dass die Preise stabil bleiben könnten

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: Andere Äußerungen deuten in die entgegengesetzte Richtung:

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - Betonung von **Kosteneinsparungsprogrammen**, Lieferantenzugeständnissen oder neuen Beschaffungen, die Zölle ausgleichen.

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - Aussagen, dass das Unternehmen **Marktanteile priorisiert** statt Marge.

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - Beweise für **eine weiche Nachfrage**, die Preiserhöhungen riskanter macht.

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - Kommentare, dass **der Wettbewerb in der Kategorie intensiv bleibt**.

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## Welche Kategorien zu beobachten sind

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: Die Zollbelastung variiert je nach Sektor stark.

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: Unternehmen, die stark auf importierte Fertigwaren oder Komponenten wie Bekleidung, Schuhe, Unterhaltungselektronik, Spielzeug, Möbel, Haushaltsgeräte und Autoteile angewiesen sind, haben in diesen Konferenzen oft mehr zu sagen.

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: Einzelhändler neigen auch dazu zu diskutieren, wie sie Lieferantenverhandlungen mit Regalpreisen ausgleichen.

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: Inländisch ausgerichtete Dienstleistungsunternehmen haben im Vergleich dazu möglicherweise nur geringe direkte Belastungen, obwohl sie indirekte Effekte durch Lieferantenkosten spüren können.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## Was das für die Preise bedeuten könnte, die Sie zahlen

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: Unternehmen geben Kosten selten auf einmal weiter.

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: Der typischere Weg ist schrittweise: Margen absorbieren einen Teil der Auswirkungen, dann steigen die Preise für ausgewählte Artikel, dann dünnen sich Werbeaktionen aus.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: Infolgedessen bemerken Käufer möglicherweise kleinere Rabatte oder moderate Erhöhungen, bevor sie drastische Preisschildänderungen sehen.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: Praktische Schritte, die helfen können:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: - **Vergleichen Sie Preise über Einzelhändler hinweg** für teure Anschaffungen, da die Weitergabe je nach Verkäufer variiert.

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **Achten Sie auf Verkaufszyklen.** Saisonal bedingte Werbeaktionen sind in Kategorien mit hoher Importbelastung möglicherweise weniger großzügig.

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - **Erwägen Sie Handelsmarken oder Alternativen**, bei denen der Qualitätsunterschied gering ist.

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - **Planen Sie größere Anschaffungen** nach Möglichkeit mit etwas Flexibilität, da sich die Preise von Quartal zu Quartal ändern können.

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## Die Vorbehalte

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: Telefonkonferenzen zu Ergebnissen sind zukunftsorientiert, und zukunftsorientierte Aussagen können sich ändern.

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.
segments.tr: Politische Entscheidungen zum Handel können sich verschieben, Ausnahmen können gewährt oder aufgehoben werden, und Unternehmenspläne können sich mit der Nachfrage und dem Wettbewerb weiterentwickeln.

segments.src: Executives also have incentives to present their plans in the best light.
segments.tr: Führungskräfte haben auch Anreize, ihre Pläne im besten Licht zu präsentieren.

segments.src: Treat any single comment as one data point and look for patterns across companies in the same industry.
segments.tr: Behandeln Sie jeden einzelnen Kommentar als einen Datenpunkt und suchen Sie nach Mustern bei Unternehmen derselben Branche.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: Over the coming weeks, the tone and specifics of tariff discussions on earnings calls will offer one of the clearest windows into how trade costs are moving through the economy.
segments.tr: In den kommenden Wochen werden der Ton und die Besonderheiten der Zolldiskussionen in Telefonkonferenzen zu Ergebnissen eines der klarsten Fenster dafür bieten, wie sich Handelskosten durch die Wirtschaft bewegen.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether companies are absorbing, offsetting, or passing along costs, and to how confident they sound about customer demand.
segments.tr: Achten Sie darauf, ob Unternehmen Kosten absorbieren, ausgleichen oder weitergeben und wie zuversichtlich sie in Bezug auf die Kundennachfrage klingen.

segments.src: Those details will go a long way toward explaining what prices may look like in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Diese Details werden maßgeblich dazu beitragen zu erklären, wie die Preise in den kommenden Monaten aussehen könnten.

segments.src: Because executives face direct questions from analysts, the calls often reveal more than a press release does, including how confident management is in its own plans.
segments.tr: Vì các giám đốc điều hành phải đối mặt với các câu hỏi trực tiếp từ các nhà phân tích, các cuộc gọi thường tiết lộ nhiều hơn một thông cáo báo chí, bao gồm cả sự tự tin của ban quản lý vào các kế hoạch của chính họ.

segments.src: ## Key phrases and what they usually mean
segments.tr: ## Các cụm từ chính và ý nghĩa thông thường của chúng

segments.src: Tariff commentary tends to come in a fairly predictable vocabulary.
segments.tr: Bình luận về thuế quan có xu hướng sử dụng vốn từ vựng khá dễ đoán.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language translation.
segments.tr: Dưới đây là bản dịch bằng ngôn ngữ thông thường.

segments.src: **"We are mitigating the impact."**
segments.tr: **"Chúng tôi đang giảm thiểu tác động."**

segments.src: The company is trying to reduce the hit through supplier negotiations, changing where products are sourced, redesigning products, or cutting other costs.
segments.tr: Công ty đang cố gắng giảm bớt đòn giáng thông qua các cuộc đàm phán với nhà cung cấp, thay đổi nguồn cung ứng sản phẩm, thiết kế lại sản phẩm hoặc cắt giảm các chi phí khác.

segments.src: It does not necessarily mean prices will stay flat.
segments.tr: Điều đó không nhất thiết có nghĩa là giá sẽ đi ngang.

segments.src: **"We expect to absorb a portion of the cost."**
segments.tr: **"Chúng tôi kỳ vọng sẽ gánh vác một phần chi phí."**

segments.src: Profit margins will take some of the pressure for now.
segments.tr: Biên lợi nhuận sẽ chịu một phần áp lực hiện tại.

segments.src: Absorption is usually temporary, and the longer duties stay in place, the harder it is to sustain.
segments.tr: Việc gánh vác thường là tạm thời, và thuế giữ nguyên càng lâu thì càng khó duy trì.

segments.src: **"Selective price increases."**
segments.tr: **"Tăng giá có chọn lọc."**

segments.src: Not every product will cost more.
segments.tr: Không phải mọi sản phẩm đều sẽ đắt hơn.

segments.src: Companies often raise prices on items where demand is strong, competition is limited, or tariff exposure is highest, while holding steady on staples or promotional items.
segments.tr: Các công ty thường tăng giá đối với các mặt hàng có nhu cầu mạnh, cạnh tranh hạn chế hoặc có mức độ phơi bày thuế quan cao nhất, đồng thời giữ ổn định đối với các mặt hàng thiết yếu hoặc khuyến mại.

segments.src: **"Surgical" or "targeted" pricing.**
segments.tr: **Định giá "phẫu thuật" hoặc "có mục tiêu".**

segments.src: Similar to the above.
segments.tr: Tương tự như trên.

segments.src: Expect changes by category or brand rather than across-the-board hikes.
segments.tr: Mong đợi những thay đổi theo danh mục hoặc thương hiệu thay vì tăng giá trên diện rộng.

segments.src: **"Pull-forward" or "inventory ahead of tariffs."**
segments.tr: **"Kéo về trước" hoặc "hàng tồn kho trước thuế quan."**

segments.src: The company bought extra goods before duties rose.
segments.tr: Công ty đã mua thêm hàng hóa trước khi thuế tăng.

segments.src: This can delay price changes, but once that lower-cost inventory sells through, higher costs may appear in later quarters.
segments.tr: Điều này có thể trì hoãn việc thay đổi giá, nhưng khi lượng hàng tồn kho chi phí thấp đó bán hết, chi phí cao hơn có thể xuất hiện trong các quý sau.

segments.src: **"Elasticity."**
segments.tr: **"Độ co giãn."**

segments.src: How sensitive customers are to price changes.
segments.tr: Mức độ nhạy cảm của khách hàng đối với việc thay đổi giá.

segments.src: When executives discuss elasticity, they are weighing whether shoppers will trade down, delay purchases, or walk away if prices rise.
segments.tr: Khi các giám đốc điều hành thảo luận về độ co giãn, họ đang cân nhắc xem người mua sắm có chuyển sang hàng rẻ hơn, trì hoãn mua hàng hay bỏ đi nếu giá tăng hay không.

segments.src: ## What analysts tend to press on
segments.tr: ## Những gì các nhà phân tích thường thúc ép

segments.src: Listen for the questions as much as the answers.
segments.tr: Hãy lắng nghe các câu hỏi cũng như câu trả lời.

segments.src: Common lines of inquiry include:
segments.tr: Các dòng câu hỏi phổ biến bao gồm:

segments.src: 1. **How much is the tariff exposure, in dollars or percentage points of margin?** Specific figures suggest a company has done detailed planning; vague answers may signal uncertainty.
segments.tr: 1. **Mức độ phơi bày thuế quan là bao nhiêu, tính bằng đô la hay điểm phần trăm biên lợi nhuận?** Các con số cụ thể cho thấy công ty đã lên kế hoạch chi tiết; các câu trả lời mơ hồ có thể báo hiệu sự không chắc chắn.

segments.src: 2. **What share of products or inputs come from affected countries?** Companies with diversified supply chains may have more flexibility.
segments.tr: 2. **Tỷ lệ sản phẩm hoặc đầu vào đến từ các quốc gia bị ảnh hưởng là bao nhiêu?** Các công ty có chuỗi cung ứng đa dạng có thể có nhiều sự linh hoạt hơn.

segments.src: 3. **How quickly can sourcing shift?** Moving production is slow and expensive, so near-term relief is limited.
segments.tr: 3. **Có thể chuyển dịch nguồn cung ứng nhanh đến mức nào?** Việc di dời sản xuất diễn ra chậm và tốn kém, vì vậy cứu trợ ngắn hạn là hạn chế.

segments.src: 4. **Are competitors raising prices too?** If rivals move first, others often follow.
segments.tr: 4. **Các đối thủ cạnh tranh có đang tăng giá không?** Nếu đối thủ di chuyển trước, những người khác thường làm theo.

segments.src: 5. **How is consumer demand holding up?** Strong demand gives companies room to pass costs along; weak demand makes them hesitate.
segments.tr: 5. **Nhu cầu của người tiêu dùng đang duy trì ra sao?** Nhu cầu mạnh mẽ tạo cho các công ty dư địa để chuyển chi phí sang; nhu cầu yếu khiến họ do dự.

segments.src: ## Signals that price increases may be coming
segments.tr: ## Các tín hiệu cho thấy việc tăng giá có thể sắp diễn ra

segments.src: While every business is different, several signals on a call often precede higher consumer prices:
segments.tr: Mặc dù mỗi doanh nghiệp là khác nhau, một số tín hiệu trong cuộc họp thường báo trước giá tiêu dùng cao hơn:

segments.src: - Guidance that **lowers expected margins** and attributes it to trade costs.
segments.tr: - Hướng dẫn **làm giảm biên lợi nhuận dự kiến** và quy cho chi phí thương mại.

segments.src: - Language shifting from "absorbing" to "partially offsetting" or "recovering" costs.
segments.tr: - Ngôn ngữ chuyển từ "hấp thụ" sang "bù đắp một phần" hoặc "thu hồi" chi phí.

segments.src: - Mentions of **list price changes** or "price realization" in upcoming quarters.
segments.tr: - Nhắc đến việc **thay đổi giá niêm yết** hoặc "thực hiện giá" trong các quý tới.

segments.src: - Comments that **promotions will be reduced**, which quietly raises the effective price shoppers pay.
segments.tr: - Nhận xét rằng **các chương trình khuyến mại sẽ bị cắt giảm**, điều này âm thầm làm tăng giá thực tế mà người mua sắm phải trả.

segments.src: - Talk of **smaller package sizes or fewer features** at the same price, sometimes called shrinkflation.
segments.tr: - Nói về **kích thước bao bì nhỏ hơn hoặc ít tính năng hơn** với cùng mức giá, đôi khi được gọi là lạm phát thu nhỏ.

segments.src: ## Signals that prices may hold steady
segments.tr: ## Các tín hiệu cho thấy giá có thể giữ ổn định

segments.src: Other remarks point in the opposite direction:
segments.tr: Các nhận xét khác chỉ ra hướng ngược lại:

segments.src: - Emphasis on **cost savings programs**, supplier concessions, or new sourcing that offsets duties.
segments.tr: - Nhấn mạnh vào **các chương trình tiết kiệm chi phí**, nhượng bộ từ nhà cung cấp hoặc nguồn cung ứng mới bù đắp thuế quan.

segments.src: - Statements that the company is **prioritizing market share** over margin.
segments.tr: - Các tuyên bố rằng công ty đang **ưu tiên thị phần** hơn biên lợi nhuận.

segments.src: - Evidence of **soft demand**, which makes price increases riskier.
segments.tr: - Bằng chứng về **nhu cầu yếu**, làm cho việc tăng giá trở nên rủi ro hơn.

segments.src: - Commentary that **competition remains intense** in the category.
segments.tr: - Bình luận rằng **cạnh tranh vẫn rất gay gắt** trong danh mục này.

segments.src: ## Which categories to watch
segments.tr: ## Các danh mục cần theo dõi

segments.src: Tariff exposure varies widely by sector.
segments.tr: Mức độ phơi bày thuế quan thay đổi đáng kể theo ngành.

segments.src: Companies that rely heavily on imported finished goods or components, such as apparel, footwear, consumer electronics, toys, furniture, appliances, and auto parts, often have more to say on these calls.
segments.tr: Các công ty phụ thuộc nhiều vào hàng hóa hoàn chỉnh hoặc linh kiện nhập khẩu, chẳng hạn như hàng may mặc, giày dép, điện tử tiêu dùng, đồ chơi, đồ nội thất, thiết bị gia dụng và phụ tùng ô tô, thường có nhiều điều để nói trong các cuộc gọi này.

segments.src: Retailers also tend to discuss how they are balancing vendor negotiations with shelf prices.
segments.tr: Các nhà bán lẻ cũng có xu hướng thảo luận về cách họ cân bằng các cuộc đàm phán với nhà vendor với giá trên kệ.

segments.src: Domestic-focused service businesses may have comparatively little direct exposure, though they can still feel indirect effects through supplier costs.
segments.tr: Các doanh nghiệp dịch vụ tập trung trong nước có thể có ít phơi bày trực tiếp hơn tương đối, mặc dù họ vẫn có thể cảm nhận được tác động gián tiếp thông qua chi phí nhà cung cấp.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for the prices you pay
segments.tr: ## Điều đó có thể có ý nghĩa gì đối với giá bạn phải trả

segments.src: Companies rarely pass costs along all at once.
segments.tr: Các công ty hiếm khi chuyển chi phí sang cùng một lúc.

segments.src: The more typical path is gradual: margins absorb some of the impact, then prices rise on selected items, then promotions thin out.
segments.tr: Con đường điển hình hơn là dần dần: biên lợi nhuận gánh một phần tác động, sau đó giá tăng trên các mặt hàng được chọn, sau đó các chương trình khuyến mại thưa dần.

segments.src: As a result, shoppers may notice smaller discounts or modest increases before they see dramatic sticker changes.
segments.tr: Kết quả là, người mua sắm có thể nhận thấy mức giảm giá nhỏ hơn hoặc mức tăng khiêm tốn trước khi họ thấy những thay đổi lớn về nhãn dán.

segments.src: Practical steps that may help:
segments.tr: Các bước thực tế có thể giúp ích:

segments.src: - **Compare prices across retailers** for big-ticket purchases, since pass-through varies by seller.
segments.tr: - **So sánh giá giữa các nhà bán lẻ** đối với các giao dịch mua sắm lớn, vì việc chuyển tiếp thay đổi tùy theo người bán.

segments.src: - **Watch for sales cycles.** Seasonal promotions may be less generous in categories with high import exposure.
segments.tr: - **Theo dõi chu kỳ giảm giá.** Các chương trình khuyến mại theo mùa có thể ít hào phóng hơn ở các danh mục có mức độ phơi bày nhập khẩu cao.

segments.src: - **Consider store brands or alternatives** where the quality difference is small.
segments.tr: - **Xem xét các nhãn hàng riêng của cửa hàng hoặc các lựa chọn thay thế** nơi sự khác biệt về chất lượng là nhỏ.

segments.src: - **Plan major purchases** with some flexibility if you can, since prices can change from quarter to quarter.
segments.tr: - **Lên kế hoạch mua sắm lớn** với một số sự linh hoạt nếu bạn có thể, vì giá có thể thay đổi từ quý này sang quý khác.

segments.src: ## The caveats
segments.tr: ## Những lưu ý

segments.src: Earnings calls are forward-looking, and forward-looking statements can change.
segments.tr: Các cuộc họp báo cáo thu nhập hướng tới tương lai và các tuyên bố hướng tới tương lai có thể thay đổi.

segments.src: Policy decisions on trade may shift, exemptions may be granted or removed, and company plans can evolve with demand and competition.
segments.tr: Các quyết định chính sách về thương mại có thể dịch chuyển, các trường hợp miễn trừ có thể được cấp hoặc xóa bỏ, và các kế hoạch của công ty có thể tiến hóa cùng với nhu cầu và sự cạnh tranh.

segments.src: Executives also have incentives to present their plans in the best light.
segments.tr: Các giám đốc điều hành cũng có động lực để trình bày các kế hoạch của họ dưới ánh sáng tốt nhất.

segments.src: Treat any single comment as one data point and look for patterns across companies in the same industry.
segments.tr: Hãy coi bất kỳ nhận xét đơn lẻ nào là một điểm dữ liệu và tìm kiếm các mô hình trên các công ty trong cùng ngành.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: Over the coming weeks, the tone and specifics of tariff discussions on earnings calls will offer one of the clearest windows into how trade costs are moving through the economy.
segments.tr: Trong những tuần tới, giọng điệu và các chi tiết cụ thể của các cuộc thảo luận về thuế quan trong các cuộc họp báo cáo thu nhập sẽ cung cấp một trong những cửa sổ rõ ràng nhất về cách chi phí thương mại đang di chuyển qua nền kinh tế.

segments.src: Pay attention to whether companies are absorbing, offsetting, or passing along costs, and to how confident they sound about customer demand.
segments.tr: Hãy chú ý đến việc các công ty đang hấp thụ, bù đắp hay chuyển chi phí sang, và đến mức độ tự tin của họ về nhu cầu của khách hàng.

segments.src: Those details will go a long way toward explaining what prices may look like in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Những chi tiết đó sẽ đóng góp rất nhiều vào việc giải thích giá cả có thể trông như thế nào trong những tháng tới.
